title: Kafka's Trial as a description of a spectral angelic bureaucracy

tellings.quote: I wrote an essay um interpreting Kafka's trial uh that's in my anthology lovers of Sophia

plain: Franz Kafka's novel The Trial, set in a city like Prague, can be read as a description of a ghostly bureaucracy of angels that rules over people. The philosopher Jason Jorjani makes this argument on the show, saying he wrote an essay interpreting the novel that appears in his anthology Lovers of Sophia, and he also draws on Kafka's private Blue Octavo Notebooks. If the reading holds, Kafka would have been describing unseen beings who run human affairs like an office.
